events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect walkthroughs worktree state
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-walkthroughs && git status --short | head -20; git log --oneline -5; git rev-parse origin/tantra-walkthroughs; ls scripts/walkthroughs/ | head -40; df -h . | tail -1

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check commit 2efde3d and webcopy.py
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-walkthroughs && git cat-file -t 2efde3d 2>&1; git branch -a --contains 2efde3d 2>&1 | head; git log --oneline -1 2efde3d 2>&1; git merge-base --is-ancestor 2efde3d HEAD && echo ancestor; sed -n 1,60p scripts/walkthroughs/webcopy.py

events.name: Bash
events.head: Compare master vs web copy timestamps
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-walkthroughs/app/public/wt-review && for t in */; do t=${t%/}; [ -f $t/$t-4k.mp4 ] || continue; m=$(stat -f %m $t/$t-4k.mp4); w=$(stat -f %m $t/web/$t.mp4 2>/dev/null || echo 0); echo "$t master=$(date -r $m +%m-%dT%H:%M) web=$(date -r $w +%m-%dT%H:%M) $([ $m -gt $w ] && echo STALE)"; done

events.text: Web copies are all newer than their masters by mtime, but I'll re-export the 5 named tools anyway so the copies are guaranteed to match the current masters.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Re-export web copies for 5 tools
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-walkthroughs/scripts/walkthroughs && python3 webcopy.py kie stripe hubspot zoho wistia 2>&1 | tail -8

events.name: Bash
